# ChurchBooks repository instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide source of truth. Before accounting, release, fund, UX, import, or phase-research work, load the corresponding `.clinerules/` and `.cline/skills/*/SKILL.md` guidance. Preserve the Phase 2 accounting baseline, transactional staging/rollback architecture, Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility, NuGet vulnerability auditing, local-first privacy, ChurchBooks branding, and licensing-last boundary.
